rv.q: Here you have a 85-minute comedy show, expertly staged in a nightlife district, that would be a good time for all kinds of folks maybe heading later to one of Old Town's bars or eateries. Chris Jones is a Tribune critic. cjones5@chicagotribune.com Review: “Zac Efron” (3 stars) When: Through July 21 Where: A Red Orchid Theatre, 1531 N.
This world premiere, directed with passion and polish by Emmy Award-winner Alan Muraoka, is an outstanding and extremely entertaining inaugural production for this new theatre company.

The dynamic chemistry between Wai Yim and Hansel Tan on stage was incredible. Their performances were masterful, delivering charm, wit, and several moments of enthralling emotional depth that resonated with the audience.
Though this 90-minute comedy has a few bumps and hiccups, it is the start of something magnificent.
This story is very touching, and the performances are highly memorable. So go ahead and buy your tickets to see this production now!
